video.title: FULLTANK SATURDAY: You’re Not Buried. You’re Planted.
video.description:
Are you going through a dark, overwhelming season where it feels like your dreams, finances, or relationships are completely covered in dirt? Remember that being buried and being planted look identical in the dark, so trust God beneath the soil—because this isn't your ending, it's just the beginning of your growth. 

#FULLTANKwithBroBo #FULLTANKwithBroBo2026 #BoSanchez #YoureNotBuriedYourePlanted #TrustGodInTheDark #SeasonOfGrowth #FaithInAction #SpiritualMaturity #TrulyRichMindset #SundayIsComing #Grace

---
PS. Do you want to help spread God’s love too?
You can support my mission through Fulltank, the Prayer Room, and other ministries by becoming a partner at bosanchez.ph/supporters.
Together, we can reach more hearts for God!

comments.author: @randyvidal1057
comments.text:
May the Lord Jesus put his hands on our eyes also, for then we too shall begin to look not at what is seen but at what is not seen. May he open the eyes that are concerned not with the present but with what is yet to come, may he unseal the heart's vision, that we may gaze on God in the Spirit, through the same Lord, Jesus Christ, whose glory and power will endure throughout the unending succession of ages. Amen. Lord, my strength and my fortress, my refuge in time of distress, to you the nations will come from the ends of the earth and say, "Our ancestors possessed nothing but false gods, worthless idols that did them no good." Jeremiah 16:19, NIV
Lord our God, we come to you burdened and driven by every kind of need and oppression, but you will bring light into every situation; in your great goodness and faithfulness you will continue to help. We come to you because you are our help. We want to draw strength from your Word so that we can remain steadfast in these times, awaiting your help and already finding joy and certainty in our expectation. For your kingdom is coming, and your will is being done on earth as in Heaven. In Jesus Christ Name. Amen.
